description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of Git's diff functionality. It includes setup, test execution, and validation commands, utilizing sourced libraries and executing Git commands to verify diff behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success, runs the provided commands, and validates the output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, signaling test completion.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares expected and actual patch outputs for diff tests.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or data streams for differences.
